title: Engine fact
description: One finding about what an engine does, with the checks that support it. Stored as characterization/<engine>/facts/<id>.json. Prose fields take a string or a list of paragraphs (Markdown, joined by blank lines).

id.description: Stable id: the engine, a dash, then a number or slug (duckdb-R5, polars-var-algorithm). The file is named <id>.json.

title.description: A short name for the finding.

verdict.description: One line for the summary table.

options.description: The checklist items the fact settles: ids of characterization/areas.json (the core's options and the extra items).

rows.description: The rows of the engine choice tables the fact settles: a function group of SubstraitLean/Functions.lean (`groups`; omitted for an option no group takes, such as null_order), one of its options, and the types the fact's checks cover. `python -m sverify_dev.facts --coverage <engine>` lists the rows and their types.

evidence.description: The strongest check in the provenance, weakest first: docs (the engine's documentation), source (its source at the release tag), engine_test (the engine's own tests with an expected result, at the tag: DuckDB's sqllogictests, Polars's unit tests; read or replayed), probe (edge cases run on the engine: probes, replays, repros), fuzz (differential fuzzing against the reference), proof (a Lean lemma covers it). It must equal the strongest provenance method's level.

layer.description: semantics (default): what a plan computes. frontend: how the engine's SQL text becomes a plan. io: how the engine reaches data (extensions, catalogs, object stores, credentials), outside what a plan computes.

constructs.description: The SQL functions, operators or plan nodes concerned.

settings.description: Engine settings the fact depends on, with the value it holds under (a list when it was checked under each).

reference.description: What Substrait and sverify's reference semantics (Rel.eval, verify) do.

status.description: deviation: Lean disagrees with the reference; fixed: it did and no longer does; decided: an open choice, now decided; shimmed: the engine needs sverify's SQL to rewrite it; no-finding: the engine or Lean already gives the reference; open: undecided; workaround: (io) the engine needs settings or a usage the fact gives.

ledger_entries.description: About how many replay ledger entries show it.

method.description: Its evidence level: docs → docs, source-reading → source, engine-test and replay → engine_test, probe and manual-repro → probe, fuzz → fuzz, proof → proof.

checked_by.description: The tool, session or commit that ran the check.

evidence.description: A link (source at a tag or commit, docs, a test), a file of this repository (a ledger, probes.json, a test), a probe in it, or a SQL repro with what it gave.

file.description: A path from the repository root.

probe.description: A construct of the probe file named by file.
